notes.title: Improved lighting, new locations, and customizable controls
notes.content:
Greetings Dead of Night fans!

I'm very excited to announce some major updates to the game. I have been working tirelessly to improve the game and enhance the overall player experience. Here are some of the improvements I’ve made:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014216/123463f60ba5666586551439eff2d9671f55ee2a.png


 Better Lighting: I’ve added more realistic lighting to enhance the creepy and eerie atmosphere of the game. You’ll feel like you’re really in the middle of the apocalypse.

 Toggle Momentum: I heard your feedback and have added an option to toggle momentum when running. You can now customize your gameplay experience to your liking.

 New Locations: I’ve added more locations to explore and discover, including sewers, towns, and more.

 Procedurally Generated Dialogue: I’ve added a new system for generating dialogue, so each playthrough will be unique and different.


I'm not ready to announce a release date just yet but stay tuned for more information. I'm confident that these updates will make In the Dead of Night an even more immersive and terrifying experience. Expect these updates to come to the demo in the next day or so.

Thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon.

notes.title: Demo Update + New Logo
notes.content:
Small Update

I've changed a few things to improve the overall experience of playing the demo. This is actually the second update since Next Fest started so I'll include the previous changes here as well. I'm listening to player feedback as well so expect another update before Next Fest is over and make sure you leave your thoughts and first impressions (but please be kind I'm a one-man team). Here's a list of some of the things that were changed in the last two updates:


 New graphics for powerups
 New HUD displays powerups collected
 HUD also displays how many powerups you've stacked (x2, x3, etc)
 Menu now includes an option to leave feedback on Reddit (should I link to the steam page as well?)
 Exiting the pause menu is less jarring now. The red flash has been removed.
 Pausing the game no longer causes glitches
 Boss battles no longer cause minor glitches
 Better FX overall


Shiny new logo!

I've updated the in-game look of the logo and menus a bit and I've changed all the graphics on the steam page to match, Let me know what you think.

Well, that's all for today. Thanks so much for playing!
